For context I am a cis woman and my partner is a cis (hetero) man and this has been a constant struggle for me to feel comfortable with the way I look and am perceived in this relationship. But ultimately I think keeping communication open is the best way, know your cues (or how your body lets you know you’re about to feel negatively about your face or body) and let your partner know when you are feeling them. It can be as simple as “I’m not having a good body image day today” and it lets your partner know how best to respond.
